astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Perseids from Perseus
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: This was a good year for the Perseids meteor shower.  A key reason was the Moon was absent from lighting up Earth's night sky so that more meteors were visible than usual.  Where was the Moon?  It was busy visiting the Sun.
